comment: Amazing person. Very personable and willing to help. There are some non-dancing assignments that will require some attention, but nothing too hard. Class is super fun!

I'd never had formal dance training and did fine in Ballet I, but it's only an easy A if you don't blow it off. Classes are probably 80% dancing, but you'll probably still want to practice outside of class. Would recommend flashcards for memorizing terminology, and do one or two extra credit assignments right off the bat to have a cushion!

Decent amount of papers but they are easy. As long as you put in thought, you will get a decent grade on them. For class, teacher is understanding of lack of familiarity with dance. It's again about just making progress and putting in effort. She's understanding, flexible, and makes the class fun.

Professor Turner was a lovely professor, kind, and gives good feedback to help you improve. I wouldn't recommend this class to a total beginner, but someone that has some dance experience may enjoy it. It can be quite the workout as well. I wrote more papers for this class than for my other 4 classes combined, but they aren't hard assignments

If you learned ballet when you were little and enjoyed it, I would highly recommend taking this class. It's a nice break from other classes, but it does really become a workout around mid-semester. Her assignments aren't terrible - get used to some writing, but I think she's a fairly easy grader.

I had never danced before and was taking this class to fulfill my arts requirement. After reading her reviews I was concerned, but I showed up every day to class and although I was not nearly as good of a dancer as my other classmates she recognized my improvement. She has high expectations but she is patient with students new to dance.

I would genuinely only recommend this Gen Ed class to someone I disliked or to someone that has extensive dance background. She has very high and unrealistic expectations, especially for a GenEd. I had more papers than I had in my other classes and her grading is absurd. I even have some dance background. Cannot imagine if I didn't

I have taken 3 classes with Ms Turner and find her to be incredibly patient, helpful, and conscious of different levels of dance ability. She wants to help you improve but she never criticizes you for being where you are. She has a bit of a quirky personality but she's generally very nice and easygoing, but you have to actually TRY in her classes.
If you haven't danced before, the class will be hard.  If you have, however, it's an easy A.  Professor Turner is very nice and encouraging, but she has high expectations.

Do not take her classes especially you did not learn dances before! The course is demanding! A lot of papers to write and performances to watch! It is not easy to get an A in this class. Turner is a harsh teacher!

Its impossible to get an A in her class, because she required a lot and always gave you a low score. In the beginning Jazz dance, we wrote five papers, more than my history class did, and I got low score. Can you believe it is a dance class? If you are curious about her class, just don't go!!!
Awesome! Extremely helpful and inspiring to all beginning dancers.
